comparison.objective: Lower a hoist-suspended motor onto four mounting studs and leave the chain slack; candidate installs a lifting pin, transfers a workpiece onto fixture pads, and removes the pin.
comparison.physical_skill: Pendant-controlled hoist lowering plus steering a suspended multi-hole load onto studs versus close-clearance pin installation, mechanical retention, shackle lifting, fixture seating, button-held extraction.
comparison.success_condition: Four motor feet flat over studs with slack chain, released controls, and safety gates versus locked-pin pull resistance, a 30 mm supported lift, three-pad seating, complete pin removal, clearance, and 3 s dwell.
comparison.reason: This is the closest record because both test suspended-load alignment and support transfer, but the candidate additionally makes installation, load-bearing verification, unlocking, and recovery of temporary lifting hardware the tested mechanism; both rubrics are sufficiently specified.
